Example subset of the World Flora Online taxonomic backbone (WorldFlora)

Source: R/data.R
WFO.example.Rd

The example data set of WorldFlora, unchanged: a small subset of an earlier release of the World Flora Online taxonomic backbone. Kept so that code written for WorldFlora keeps working; the examples of this package use WFO.example2026, an extract of the WFO Plant List 2026-06.

Usage

WFO.example

Format

A data.frame with 13 rows and the columns of the WFO backbone of that release (taxonID, scientificName, scientificNameAuthorship, taxonRank, family, genus, specificEpithet, infraspecificEpithet, verbatimTaxonRank, taxonomicStatus, acceptedNameUsageID, ...).

Source

World Flora Online. https://www.worldfloraonline.org

Examples

data(WFO.example)
WFO.match("Faidherbia albida", WFO.data = WFO.example)$scientificName
#> 
#> Checking new accepted IDs
#> [1] "Faidherbia albida"
